name: Pine Tree Camp
description_short: A fully accessible 285-acre camp in Maine's Belgrade Lakes Region for children and adults with developmental and physical disabilities, with a 3:1 camper-to-counselor ratio. Programs range from day-long experiences to week-long overnight sessions for children, adults and families.
special_needs_notes: Every camper must have a developmental or physical disability. The camp says it accommodates individual campers' needs so they can try any activity, keeps a 3:1 camper-to-counselor ratio, and has nurses on site 24 hours a day during overnight sessions to give medication and medical care.
swim_waterfront_notes: There is an accessible waterfront on North Pond with an aquatics program that teaches swimming techniques suited to each camper. Boating, paddling and fishing from pontoon boats and a fishing dock are also offered.

age_max is left empty because the programs include adults with no upper age limit. The children's programs run from age 5 to 18.
